Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class PidPressureReliefValidator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.PidPressureReliefValidator
public final class PidPressureReliefValidator extends Object
Binds passive relief configuration, actual routes and executed sampled evidence to canonical P&ID identities.

This contract supports an exact native SafetyReliefValve on a real two-outlet splitter. It does not establish certified capacity, flare adequacy, installed independence, SIL, continuous safety or standards approval. A required criterion FAIL remains an observed FAIL.

  • Method Details

    • applyCanonicalConfiguration

      public static PidPressureReliefValidator.ConfiguredRelief applyCanonicalConfiguration(EngineeringProject project, PidDesignModel model, PidSimulationBindings bindings, ProcessSystem process, String reliefTag)
      Applies supported canonical mechanical settings to the exact valve in an isolated process copy.

      Only scalar pressure/lift/Cv settings are applied. Other native hydraulic settings must already equal the governed readback and cannot be silently changed. Revalidate before execution.

      Parameters:
      project - governed source project
      model - canonical proposal graph
      bindings - fresh bindings for this graph
      process - actual isolated configured copy, never the project source
      reliefTag - canonical relief tag
      Returns:
      validated configuration after exact native setter/readback
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if settings, native type, route or readback disagree

    • applyCanonicalConfiguration

      backpressureOverrideBara - optional explicit case boundary disturbance
      Returns:

      Throws:

    • attachResult

      public static Map<String,Object> attachResult(PidPressureReliefValidator.ConfiguredRelief configured, DynamicSafetyScenario scenario, DynamicSafetyScenarioResult result, Set<String> maintainedCriteria)
      Attaches actual passive-response evidence, preserving required FAILs and missing/full-window status.

      result - actual native result from the governed strict runner

      Throws:
